Job Description:

The Quality Manager is responsible for leading the quality assurance function and driving continuous improvement across all operational processes. This role champions a data-driven culture, leveraging analytics to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for process optimization. The Quality Manager collaborates with cross-functional teams to implement best practices, ensure compliance with internal and external standards, and deliver superior customer experiences.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Quality Leadership:
    • Develop, implement, and maintain quality management systems, policies, and procedures aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
    • Lead and mentor a team of Quality Analysts and other quality professionals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
  • Process Improvement:

    • Collaborate with operations, customer service, and other departments to streamline workflows, eliminate inefficiencies, and enhance service delivery.

  • Data Analysis & Reporting:
    • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for quality and process efficiency.
    • Analyze quality data, audit findings, and operational metrics to uncover trends, anomalies, and root causes of defects.
    • Prepare and present actionable insights and recommendations to senior management, supporting data-driven decision-making.
  • Business Insights

  • Risk Management:

Job Description:

Role Summary

Develop, test, and deploy AI agents that automate regulated and semi-regulated business processes using AWS Bedrock. Build and maintain document-processing pipelines that extract structured information from enterprise documents and integrate it into AI-driven workflows, helping replace manual processes with intelligent automation.

Key Responsibilities

Agent Development

  • Develop AI agents on AWS Bedrock (Amazon Nova and other foundation models) for document generation, data validation, and case intake use cases.
  • Implement business logic using AWS Fargate following established service patterns (e.g., email-triggered and chatbot-triggered workflows).
  • Integrate AI services with Microsoft Graph API for Microsoft Teams messaging, file handling, and delivery of agent outputs.
  • Develop and maintain prompts, agent configurations, and guardrails to ensure reliable and compliant AI behavior.
  • Perform unit and integration testing to validate agent accuracy, performance, and response quality.
  • Troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance AI agent workflows based on testing results and user feedback.
  • Collaborate with solution architects, QA teams, and business stakeholders to deliver production-ready AI solutions.

Document Processing

  • Develop and maintain document-processing services using AWS Fargate.
  • Build extraction pipelines for structured and semi-structured documents using OCR and Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) technologies.
  • Integrate third-party document extraction tools into AI workflows.
  • Support validation and quality improvements of extracted data to meet business and audit requirements.
  • Optimize document extraction accuracy through testing and continuous improvements.
  • Assist in deploying document-processing services into production environments.

Qualifications:

Required Experience

  • 3–5 years of software development experience, with at least 1–2 years developing Generative AI or LLM-based applications.
  • Hands-on experience with Python and REST API development.
  • Working knowledge of AWS services, preferably AWS Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SQS, SNS, or similar cloud-native services.
  • Experience with prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agent frameworks, or LLM orchestration tools.
  • Experience building integrations using APIs such as Microsoft Graph API or similar enterprise platforms.
  • 2+ years of experience with document processing, OCR, or Intelligent Document Processing solutions such as AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with event-driven application architecture and microservices.
  • Experience using Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with financial services, insurance, healthcare, or other regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation, prompt optimization, and model monitoring.
  • Exposure to vector databases and semantic search technologies.
  • Understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and security best practices.
  • Experience working with Docker and containerized applications.
  • Exposure to enterprise chatbot or conversational AI solutions.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to build scalable and maintainable AI solutions.
  • Effective collaboration and communication skills.
  • Attention to quality, security, and compliance.
  • Continuous learning mindset with interest in emerging AI technologies.

    Job Description:

    Seeking an experienced Client-Facing Accounting Lead to be based at our client’s Virginia office. This role will serve as the critical link between the client’s finance organization and the offshore accounting delivery team. The position will work closely with the offshore Senior Accounting Manager and accounting team, providing on-site support to the client, understanding business requirements, addressing accounting issues, coordinating deliverables, and ensuring that work is executed accurately and on time.

    The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on accounting experience, particularly in complex journal entries, reconciliations, month-end close, and accounting analysis, combined with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

    This is a bridge role—the individual will not replace the offshore accounting leadership but will work closely with them to ensure seamless coordination between the client and offshore teams.

    Key Responsibilities

    Client-Facing Responsibilities

    • Serve as the primary day-to-day accounting contact at the client location and build a strong working relationship with client finance and accounting stakeholders.
    • Understand client requirements, priorities, processes, and accounting issues and communicate them effectively to the offshore team.
    • Bridge communication and execution gaps between the client team and offshore accounting team.
    • Attend client meetings, understand business requirements, capture action items, and ensure timely follow-up with the offshore team.
    • Provide on-site support to resolve accounting questions, issues, and escalations.
    • Proactively identify potential issues and communicate risks, dependencies, and delays to the appropriate stakeholders.
    • Ensure client expectations are clearly understood and translated into actionable deliverables for the offshore team.

    Accounting Responsibilities

    • Provide hands-on support for complex accounting entries, journal entries, account reconciliations, and month-end close activities.
    • Review and analyze accounting transactions and supporting schedules prepared by the offshore team.
    • Assist in resolving complex reconciliation items, variances, and accounting discrepancies.
    • Support the client with accounting analysis and interpretation of financial information.
    • Help ensure accounting activities are performed in accordance with applicable accounting policies, internal controls, and U.S. GAAP.
    • Participate in month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities and help ensure deliverables are completed within agreed timelines.
    • Provide accounting guidance and clarification to the offshore team when required.

     

    Qualifications:

    Required Qualifications

    • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
    • 5+ years of accounting experience, preferably in a corporate, professional-services, or client-facing environment.
    • Strong hands-on experience with:
      • Complex journal entries
      • General ledger accounting
      • Balance sheet reconciliations
      • Month-end close
      • Variance analysis
      • Accounting research and analysis
    • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and accounting principles.
    • Experience working with offshore/shared-services accounting teams is highly preferred.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with both senior client stakeholders and offshore teams.
    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with ERP/accounting systems.

    Additional Information:

    All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

    EEOC and Veteran Documentation
    During employment, employees are treated without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or handicap, or any other legally protected status.
    At times, government agencies require periodic reports from employers on the sex, ethnicity, handicap, veteran and other protected status of employees. The purpose of this Administrative EEO Record is for statistical analysis only and is used to comply with government record keeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Periodic reports are made to the government on the following information. The completion of the Administrative EEO record is optional. If you choose to volunteer the requested information, please note that all 
    Administrative EEO Records are kept in a Confidential File and are not part of your Application for Employment or Personnel file.
    Please note: YOUR COOPERATION IS VOLUNTARY. INCLUSION OR EXCLUSION OF ANY DATA WILL NOT AFFECT ANY EMPLOYMENT DECISION.

Job Description: Adaptive Planning Administrator / Technical Lead

Job Title:

Adaptive Planning Administrator / Technical Lead

Reports To:

Director, FP&A Systems & Business Intelligence

Location:

Location: Remote

Role Summary:

This role includes administration and technical leadership for Workday Adaptive Planning. The position ensures system integrity, optimizes consolidation and planning processes, manages integrations with Datawarehouse and ERP’s, drives automation, streamlining of metadata, reporting improvements, & end user support.

Key Responsibilities:

Adaptive Planning Responsibilities:

  • Own the configuration and ongoing optimization of Adaptive models, including dimensions, levels, hierarchies, attributes, versions, and assumptions.
  • Administer and support modeled and cube sheets, including advanced formula development (lookups, allocations, driver-based logic).
  • Manage Data Agent processes and integrations; coordinate data flows, refresh schedules, and dependencies.
  • Own data mapping tables, transformations, and reconciliation controls; proactively monitor, triage, and resolve data load exceptions.
  • Maintain and enhance alternate reporting hierarchies to support evolving business and management reporting needs.
  • Design, build, and support Dashboards, Hubs, and Reporting solutions using HTML reporting and OfficeConnect.
  • Administer role-based security, including access provisioning, periodic reviews, and compliance with governance standards.
  • Partner with IT and EDW teams on schema changes, performance tuning, and data lineage; document interfaces, dependencies, and SLAs.
  • Support forecast, budget, and commit cycles, including version management, locks, workflow configuration, and calendar orchestration by partnering with the Finance team and ensuring timely version creation & management, updating assumptions and loading source data
  • Ensure integrity of financial data by performing tie-outs to consolidation system; investigate and resolve mapping and timing variances.
  • Develop and maintain documentation, including playbooks, SOPs, data dictionaries, and cutover/runbook materials.
  • Lead user enablement through training, office hours, and ongoing support; provide Tier 2/3 issue resolution.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the Adaptive platform, including scalability, performance optimization, and expanded enterprise adoption.
  • Support expansion of Adaptive to non-finance users by enabling standardized reporting, dashboards, and governed self-service capabilities.
  • Partner with FP&A and business stakeholders to translate planning and reporting requirements into scalable system design.
  • Support audit and compliance requirements, including change management, access controls, and documentation readiness.

 

Technical Competencies:

  • OfficeConnect  & HTML Reporting, Dashboards, & Hub development
  • Adaptive Data Agent configuration and secure data pipelines.
  • Advanced Data Management, Integrations configurations and troubleshooting.
  • Security Administration & Governance
  • Metadata, Master Data & Data Stewardship
  • Automation, Scripting & Technical Troubleshooting
  • Platform Lifecycle, Change Management & Release Control

    • Ability and experience administering a production environment
  • Workday Adaptive Planning certifications (Essentials, Integrations, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience managing integrations, automation, and reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Information Systems.
  • Strong understanding of general accounting principles, financial consolidation, and planning.

Job Description:

Job Summary

The Team Lead is responsible for leading frontline teams to achieve operational targets, deliver exceptional customer experiences, and foster employee development. This role serves as a critical link between frontline operations and management, ensuring alignment with Lenovo's customer-first philosophy, business objectives, quality standards, and productivity goals.

The Team Lead provides day-to-day leadership, coaching, and performance management while supporting operational excellence, workforce planning, employee engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, motivate, and develop frontline employees to achieve operational and customer service objectives.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and provide guidance in the absence of management.
  • Foster a positive, high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and customer satisfaction.
  • Drive employee engagement and team-building initiatives.

Coaching & Employee Development

  • Conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, and feedback discussions.
  • Create and execute individual development plans to enhance employee capabilities.
  • Identify skill gaps and coordinate training, cross-training, and upskilling opportunities.
  • Mentor team members and support their professional growth.

Operational Management

  • Manage daily operations to ensure service levels, productivity, attendance, and quality expectations are achieved.
  • Monitor workflow and staffing requirements while partnering with Workforce Management and Operations teams.
  • Ensure compliance with Lenovo policies, processes, and operational standards.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and training activities for new hires.

Performance Management & Reporting

  • Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), productivity, quality, and customer satisfaction metrics.
  • Generate and communicate performance reports to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Identify performance trends and implement action plans to improve results.
  • Drive accountability and ensure achievement of operational targets.

Customer Experience & Escalation Management

  • Support the resolution of customer escalations and complex issues.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of high-quality customer service and technical support.
  • Provide guidance to team members on customer interactions and issue resolution.
  • Promote a customer-centric culture that prioritizes satisfaction and loyalty.

Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in process improvement initiatives and operational excellence projects.
  • Recommend and implement solutions to improve efficiency, quality, and overall performance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on business and customer support initiatives.
  • Support organizational change management activities when required.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate's Degree or Bachelor's Degree preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 1-3 years of experience in a Team Lead, Supervisor, Senior Support, or similar leadership role.
  • Previous experience in a contact center, customer service, technical support, or operations environment preferred.
  • Experience managing performance, quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction metrics.
  • Experience coaching and developing employees to achieve performance goals.

Language Requirements

  • Fluent Spanish required.
  • English proficiency preferred.

The Workforce Management (WFM) Analyst is responsible for forecasting workload demand, developing staffing and capacity plans, optimizing workforce utilization, and delivering analytical insights that support service level commitments and operational performance.   • Develop short- and long-term workload forecasts and staffing requirements.
  • Create and maintain capacity plans to support service level and productivity targets.

Job Description:

*For Pooling Purposes*

Who are we looking for?

The Sourcing Manager is responsible for talent attraction of candidates with specialized positions for the company. They focus on strategic campaigns that work to create a candidate funnel for positions that are hard to fill.

The role is for Manager level, spearheading hiring projects, sourcing and marketing implementation to deliver the needed requirement for specialized positions considered as top level programs in the company. 

What will you be doing?

  • Design, build and establish specific activities both online and offline to bring in the right candidates for the job openings
  • Responsible for creating a database of candidate profiles specific to technical or special program requirements for hiring needs
  • Ensure the team can plan and implement sourcing and marketing campaigns specific to the client’s requirements of specific programs
  • Collaborate with other teams such as recruitment operations, client vendors and internal sourcing team members on the hiring needs, give direction and support for the account hiring
  • Responsible for consolidating, tracking and creating reports for the different initiatives implemented for the hiring needs, give solid recommendations and analysis for alignment
  • Build and manage the specialized hiring sourcing campaigns and provide direction for the team, ensuring that cost-per-hire are within boundary while targets are being met
  • Maintains understanding of new ways to source candidates, able to easily share learnings and builds strong learning relationships from others
  • Implement process improvement, data analysis and able to develop a continuous platform or plan to improve hiring capabilities for hard to fill classes

How will you be measured?

  • Actual acceptable fill rate vs target headcount for the specific hiring account
  • For project implementation, able to document and give comprehensive report from end-to-end project scope and performance
  • As lead, be able to implement and deliver good results for the hiring requirement
  • Give strong direction, guidance and coaching to mentor key personnel to build team camaraderie and performance
  • Acceptable cost-per-hire metrics are met with the required headcount and sourcing plan budget.

 

Qualifications:

What will make you a good fit?

  • With at least 5 years’ background in talent sourcing specialized roles for BPO hiring
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Human Resources or a related field
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Strong track record in project implementation, team presentation and analysis
  • Critical thinker with innovative problem solving skills
  • Highly computer literate and proficient in MS Office and related business / communication tools.

Job Description:

Technical Support Engineer

Enterprise Storage Platforms

Location:  Bangalore     |     Work Model:  Work from Office     |     Shift:  24x7 Rotational

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join our enterprise storage support team in a high-touch, mission-critical environment. This role is a great fit for someone with solid hands-on experience in enterprise storage and infrastructure troubleshooting who genuinely enjoys solving complex customer problems.

You will work on real-world issues across storage platforms and associated infrastructure, supporting customers through phone, email, chat, and remote sessions. You'll be expected to own cases end to end, communicate clearly under pressure, and bring structured thinking to every troubleshooting scenario.

What You'll Do

  • Provide technical support to enterprise customers on complex storage and infrastructure issues across a global 24x7 model.
  • Own cases end to end, from initial triage through troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and resolution.
  • Diagnose problems spanning storage protocols, host connectivity, controller behaviour, performance symptoms, platform interoperability, and more.
  • Troubleshoot any HW and SW issues that comes up during ongoing platform use.
  • Manage customer communication with professionalism and urgency, especially during business-impacting situations.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including escalation teams, engineering, and customer stakeholders to drive timely outcomes.
  • Maintain high-quality case notes, action plans, and technical documentation throughout the support lifecycle.
  • Adhere to SLA targets, escalation protocols, and quality standards consistently.

 

Required Experience

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience in technical support, infrastructure support, and enterprise storage support.
  • Solid track record in customer-facing troubleshooting roles within enterprise IT environments.
  • Demonstrated hands-on understanding of enterprise storage concepts and troubleshooting methodology.

 

Technical Skills

  • Storage: Strong working knowledge of SAN and NAS environments (protocols - FC, iSCSI, NFS, and CIFS/SMB), including RAID, high availability, controller architecture, disk behaviour, and failover concepts.
  • OS: Good working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration fundamentals.
  • Virtualization: Familiarity with VMware or similar virtualization platforms and their integration with storage.
  • Networking: Good grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Diagnostics: Ability to analyze logs, alerts, symptoms, and customer-reported behaviour to isolate the root cause or likely fault domain.

 

Preferred Skills

  • Experience supporting enterprise storage platforms such as NetApp ONTAP, FAS / AFF controllers, StorageGRID, E-Series, or equivalent (Dell EMC, HPE, Pure, IBM, Hitachi).
  • Prior experience in managed service or enterprise support environments handling platform or infrastructure incidents.
  • Familiarity with critical case management, and ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or equivalent).

 

How You Work

  • You communicate clearly, written and verbal and can hold your own during high-pressure customer conversations.
  • You set expectations well and follow through, even when resolution timelines are uncertain.
  • You stay composed during escalations and apply structured thinking rather than guesswork.
  • You take ownership seriously and don't pass problems without context.
  • You work well with distributed, cross-functional teams across time zones.

 

Qualifications:

Education

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.
We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.

Sutherland
Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results.

 

Job Description:

Technical Support Engineers assist NetApp Customers by providing a range of technical support including:  

  • Resolve Customer problems via the telephone, the web or AutoSupport. 
  • Research Customer issues in a timely manner and follow up directly with the Customer with recommendations and action plans. 
  • Escalate cases to other more senior Technical Support Engineers and/or Escalation Engineers when the problem is too complex or falls out of specific area of expertise. 
  • Leverage internal technical expertise, including higher-level engineers, knowledge base, and other internal tools, to add to knowledge base in order to provide solutions to customer issues. 
  • Create new knowledgebase articles to capture new learning for reuse throughout the center. 
  • Participate in technical communication within the Technical Support Engineering team to learn about new technologies and complimentary storage applications. 
  • Gain knowledge and expertise through hand-on experience, self-study, and through a variety of learning environments. Initial focus is on learning NetApp’s proprietary operating system, OnTap, and troubleshooting NetApp hardware issues. 
  • Some opportunity, after training, to work on small volumes of Top Enterprise Accounts (NetApp’s highest priority customers) and SupportEdge Premium cases (customers with a higher level of support agreement). 

Qualifications:

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English (B2 or higher) 
  • Good interpersonal communication and Customer service skills are needed in order work successfully with customers in high stress and or ambiguous situations. 
  • Basic understanding of some of the following protocols and applications: 
  • NFS, the UNIX remote file sharing protocol 
  • CIFS, the Windows NT remote file sharing protocol 
  • TCP/IP 
  • Networking 
  • RAID 
  • Microsoft Exchange and/or Veritas software. 
  • Strong aptitude for learning new technologies and understanding how to utilize them in a Customer facing environment. 
  • Ability to follow standard engineering principles  

Additional Information:

  • Competitive compensation packages inclusive of base pay, incentives, over-time and shift differentials for certain shifts. 
  • Annual merit increase based on performance. 
  • Paid Training whether onsite or in work at home. 
  • Discounts for several corporate and retail partners for services and products once Sutherland ID is presented. 
  • Excellent training and supervisory support - to help you feel comfortable servicing our customers. 
  • Competitive Salary with attractive and attainable PBI structure. 
  • Paid vacation and sick leave annually. 
  • Exceptional Health and Life Insurance Plan 
  • Paid referral program 
  • Career development & growth opportunities for advancement. 
  • Excellent Reward and recognition programs.

job.title: Customer Service Representatives - Emergency (Virginia State Residents)
job.description:
Company Description:


We’re Sutherland and we’re seeking Customer Service/Emergency Services Representatives. Join us and support one of our public utility clients while working with leading technologies and systems as well as a dedicated team of leaders and peers to support you. 

Because our client is a public utility, we support them and their customers 24/7. Employees must have full availability to work various shifts and able to work at least one weekend day.  
 

Job Description:

The Emergency Customer Service Representative will deliver excellent customer care and create sustainable value for customers via phone, email, chat, and correspondence. This includes: 
·         Agents will be handling various types of customer service calls (i.e. service requests, billing questions, energy conservation advice, etc.) 
·         Will be handling calls related to power outages and other emergency situations. 
·         Must be an active listener and can leverage probing question skills to provide resolutions. 
·         Agents will also educate customers on suppliers and energy choice programs. 
  
Pay:  

What we offer:

  • Hourly rate - $15 per hour with available performance incentives.
    • Prefer overnights? Agents working overnight shifts earn an extra $1 overnight premium! 
  • Medical, dental and vision benefits
  • Paid training & PTO
  • Advancement opportunities – 80% of our frontline leaders have been promoted from within
  • Additional pay incentives as well as monthly rewards & recognition programs
  • Employee Discounts
  • EAP & Health and Wellness programs including a personal trainer dedicated to Sutherland

 

    Qualifications:

    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
    • Full time availability 
    • Driven by solving problems and meeting goals
    • Familiar with Microsoft Office
    • Experienced in customer service with strong multi-tasking skills
    • High school diploma or equivalent

    Additional Information:

    This position must be performed from within the State of Virginia. Employees may not perform work while located outside this region.  Compliance with work-location requirements may be verified through company systems, sign-in records, security technologies and identity-verification procedures, including webcam verification as required.


    About us:

    As a digital transformation company -- and Great Place to Work certified -- Sutherland has been helping customers globally achieve greater agility and transform automated customer experiences for over 35 years. We work with some of the world’s most known brands in dozens of industries, including Banking & Financial Services; Insurance; Communications, Media & Entertainment; Healthcare; Retail & Consumer Packaged Goods; Technology; Travel, Transportation, Hospitality & Logistics; and Mortgage Services, helping them to better support and serve their customers.

    EEOC and Veteran Documentation
    During employment, employees are treated without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or handicap, or any other legally protected status.
    At times, government agencies require periodic reports from employers on the sex, ethnicity, handicap, veteran and other protected status of employees. The purpose of this Administrative EEO Record is for statistical analysis only and is used to comply with government record keeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Periodic reports are made to the government on the following information. The completion of the Administrative EEO record is optional. If you choose to volunteer the requested information, please note that all 
    Administrative EEO Records are kept in a Confidential File and are not part of your Application for Employment or Personnel file.
    Please note: YOUR COOPERATION IS VOLUNTARY. INCLUSION OR EXCLUSION OF ANY DATA WILL NOT AFFECT ANY EMPLOYMENT DECISION.

job.title: French Customer Experience & Tech Support Advisor (Flexible Hours)
job.description:
Company Description:

Build Your Career with Sutherland
Looking for a job that fits your lifestyle while offering long-term career opportunities?

At Sutherland, you'll join a global leader in Customer Experience, working with one of the world's leading consumer technology brands. Whether you're starting your career or looking for a fresh challenge, we'll provide the training, support, and development you need to succeed.

No previous technical support experience? No problem—we'll teach you everything you need to know.

Job Description:

What You'll Do

As a Customer Experience & Technical Support Advisor, you'll help French-speaking customers get the most from their devices and smart technology.

Your day-to-day will include:

  • Providing support via phone and email in French and English.
  • Assisting customers with product setup and troubleshooting.
  • Resolving connectivity and basic technical issues.
  • Delivering an outstanding customer experience on every interaction.

Qualifications:

What We're Looking For

  • French proficiency at B2 level.
  • English proficiency at B2 High (B2H) / C1 level.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Interest in technology and consumer electronics.
  • Basic knowledge of Wi-Fi, mobile devices, or connectivity is an advantage.
  • Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Availability to work from our office in Sofia.
  • Schedule: Monday to Sunday, between 10:00 and 19:00.

Additional Information:

Why Join Us?

  • Choose the schedule that suits you: 6, or 8-hour shifts.
  • Permanent employment contract.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Fully paid training.
  • 21 days of paid annual leave.
  • Additional health and life insurance.
  • Meal vouchers.
  • Company-paid lunch in the office three days per week.
  • Employer-sponsored professional certifications to boost your skills and career.
  • Clear career progression and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Modern office, supportive colleagues, and an international work environment.

 Ready to join us? Apply today and discover where your career can take you!

job.description:

Sutherland is a global leader in driving business and digital transformation, and exceptional experiences along the entire journey of our client’s engagement with their customers.  With over 35 years of experience, we combine deep domain expertise and extensive knowledge in proven optimization with both proprietary and partnered tools and platforms to drive growth, efficiency, and productivity across organizations.

job.title: Kundenservice- & Vertriebsspezialist (m/w/d) – Deutschsprachig
job.description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung:

 Über uns

Wir sind Sutherland, ein global führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Customer Experience Management (CXM) – mit über 37 Jahren Erfolgsgeschichte, mehr als 60 Standorten weltweit und seit 2017 auch im Herzen von Pristina vertreten.
Hier arbeiten über 500 Kolleginnen und Kollegen täglich daran, Service- und Verkaufserlebnisse auf höchstem Niveau zu schaffen – für renommierte Marken und Marktführer in Europa.

Unser Telekommunikationsprojekt für die Premium-Marke Europas ist eines der größten und erfolgreichsten in der Region.
Wir kombinieren exzellenten Kundenservice, moderne Technologien und verkaufsorientierte Beratung – alles mit dem Ziel, unseren Kunden das beste Erlebnis zu bieten.

Stellenbeschreibung:

 DEINE ROLLE

⟢ Als Kundenservice- & Vertriebsspezialist bist du die Stimme der bekanntesten Telekommunikationsmarke Europas.
⟢ Du hilfst Kunden nicht nur bei Fragen zu Internet, Telefonie und TV, sondern nutzt jede Gelegenheit, um bedarfsgerecht zu beraten und mit deinem Engagement Mehrwert zu schaffen.

Konkret heißt das:

⟢ Du bearbeitest Anfragen rund um Produkte und Dienstleistungen eines führenden Telekommunikationsanbieters

⟢ Du löst technische oder administrative Anliegen zuverlässig und freundlich

⟢ Du erkennst Verkaufschancen und präsentierst passende Angebote & Zusatzangebote

⟢ Du trägst aktiv zur Kundenzufriedenheit und zum Teamerfolg bei

Qualifikationen:

WAS DU MITBRINGST

✓ Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1)

✓ Freude am Kundenkontakt und am gemeinsamen Erfolg

✓ Eine kommunikative, lösungsorientierte und positive Art

✓ Motivation, dich weiterzuentwickeln und Herausforderungen anzunehmen

✓ Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Kundenservice ist ein Plus – aber keine Pflicht

Zusätzliche Informationen:

 WARUM SUTHERLAND?

🔗 Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem internationalen Unternehmen

🔗 Leistungsorientierte Vergütung & attraktive Bonusmöglichkeiten

🔗 Moderne Büroräume im Zentrum von Pristina

🔗 Teamspirit & offene Kultur – hier zählt dein Beitrag wirklich

🔗 Coaching & Weiterentwicklung durch erfahrene Führungskräfte zertifizierte Coachs aus dem Ausland

🔗 Erfolgs- und Bonusaktionen, Wettbewerbe & Anerkennung für Leistung

 

💬 KLINGT NACH DIR?

Dann warte nicht – gestalte deine Zukunft mit uns und werde Teil unserer Welt!
Bewirb dich jetzt und starte deine Karriere im Kundenservice & Vertrieb beim Telekomunikationsgiganten in Pristina.

job.title: Senior Associate - Accounts Payables
job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.
We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.

Sutherland
Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results.

Job Description:

Associates in this role get to: Be the expert:

  • Process such items as invoices, payment requests, etc.
  • Handles all vendor correspondence via phone, client requests or email
  • Works with Vendors to get updated information submitted such as address changes, banking information, etc
  • Investigates and resolves problems associated with processing of invoices
  • Reconciles various accounts by identifying errors in posting or omissions
  • Receives, researches and resolves a variety of routine internal and external inquiries concerning account status, including communicating the resolution of discrepancies to appropriate persons
  • Files, maintains, and distributes accounting documents, records and reports
  • Responds to some routine, but more complex questions related to area of responsibility
  • Audit of Travel expenses and receipts
  • Payment enquiries from both external and internal.  
  • Reviewing and processing Invoices, Non-PO Invoices,  Pre-Approved/Pre-coded Invoices - SAP USA
  • Cash Disbursement Forecast Preparation and Submission
  • Reviewing vendor statements for completeness
  • Customer Refunds Processing
  • Prepare audit package 
  • Review and Reconcile Process data

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have: -

  • Post Secondary education (CAT/ACCA, Diploma or Associate Degree)
  • Formal, specialized, job-related training with 1-3 years related work experience
  • Proven working experience as accounts payable or accounts receivable clerk - Solid understanding or basic bookkeeping and accounting payable principles
  • Hands-on experience with MS Office and ERP software such as SAP
  • High degree of accuracy and attention to detail. Customer service orientation and negotiation skills
  • Some analytical skills to identify problems in business processes and to develop workable solutions. May require assistance to determine cross functional impact
  • Knowledge of company and departmental practice and procedures related to department activities-Exposure to Process Improvements and Transformation projects.

Additional Information:

Our most successful candidates will have: - 

·         A minimum of 3-4 CXC/GCE/City and Guilds subjects inclusive of English               Language, or a U.S. high school diploma or GED. 

  • Must have a valid (not expired) government issued ID, TRN and NIS card.
  • Must be able to pass a criminal background check and drug test as needed.
  • Must have flexible availability to work any day and any assigned shift weekly.(Weekends and Public Holidays).
  • Must be able to train and / or work onsite at our Red Hills Road site.
  • 1 year of BPO/customer service experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform at a high level, to support our high volume of inbound calls.
  • Experience in customer service is an asset and preferred.
  • Good systematic problem solving ability , using sound business judgment, and following through on commitments to customers.
  • The ability to quickly and accurately identify and assess individual customer needs and take appropriate action steps to satisfy those needs.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • A passion for helping customers and exceeding their expectations with high integrity.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to tailor styles to the audience
  • See through the eyes of the customer.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to translate Customer communication rapidly and effectively on live voice or chat interactions. proficient reading skills required.
  • The ability to project patience, empathy, caring, and sincerity in written words or voice tone, depending on channel.
  • Ability to effectively organize, prioritize, multi-task and manage time.
  • Multi-tasking skills, showcased through the use of several applications; experience working with CRM applications preferred.
  • Basic PC keyboarding skills; basic Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) experience required.
  • Ability to type over 30 WPM with 80% accuracy.
  • Must be very tech savvy with strong abilities in handling troubleshooting techniques and resolving technical issues.
  • Inspire confidence and positively influence the behaviour, actions, and thoughts of others.

As your prospective employer, we need to process your Personal Data as needed to evaluate your qualification for the position you are applying for with Sutherland.  During the recruitment process, your Personal Data may be transferred outside of Jamaica and disclosed to third parties in the normal course of the recruitment and/or employment process or as needed to comply with applicable laws. This may include transferring information to our affiliated Companies for purposes connected to your employment with the company or to the management of Sutherland’s business.

job.title: Lead Cloud Security Engineer
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is an experience-led digital transformation company. Our mission is to deliver exceptionally engineered experiences for customers and employees today, that continue to delight tomorrow. For over 37 years, we have cared for our clients' customers, delivering measurable results and accelerating growth.

Job Description:

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Lead Cloud Security Engineer with 10+ years of experience in Information Security and at least 5+ years in Cloud Security implementation, and governance of security controls across multi-cloud environments (Azure, OCI, AWS, GCP). The role focuses on cloud security architecture, compliance, security operations, threat management, and continuous improvement of the organization's cloud security posture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and govern secure, scalable cloud architectures, security standards, policies, guardrails, and landing zones across multi-cloud environments.
  • Own and enhance the Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) program, ensuring alignment with NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and Cloud Security Alliance frameworks.
  • Perform threat modeling, security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and defining remediation strategies.
  • Implement and manage cloud security controls including IAM, MFA, PAM, SSO, Zero Trust, CSPM, and Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP).
  • Monitor cloud environments for threats, vulnerabilities, and misconfigurations, drive remediation with platform and application teams.
  • Investigate and respond to cloud security incidents, support forensic investigations, and integrate cloud logs into SIEM platforms.
  • Detect, investigate, and respond to cloud-based security incidents.
  • Analyze logs from cloud-native services such as Defender for Cloud, OCI Cloud Guard, AWS CloudTrail, Azure Monitor, and GCP Logging.
  • Support vulnerability management (Tannable), EDR  (Sentinel One), Stellar  XDR and Cyber AI Behavior Analytics , Defender for Office 365 email security monitoring solutions.
  • Ensure audit readiness, compliance reporting, and maintenance of cloud security documentation, standards, and procedures.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor security engineers, and collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to strengthen cloud security capabilities.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience securing Azure, OCI, and AWS and GCP environments.
  • Expertise in IAM, cloud-native security services, CSPM, CWPP, SIEM, Zero Trust, and cloud security operations.
  • Experience with threat modeling, security architecture reviews, incident response, vulnerability management, and compliance assessments.
  • Knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, and GDPR.
  • Experience with Tenable, SentinelOne, cloud logging, and security monitoring platforms.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

job.title: AWS Network Engineer - Palo Alto firewalls
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. Sutherland was founded 38 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

The purpose of this position is to provide technical assistance to the NICE Cloud Networking Team, coordinating and participating in the design, deployment, operation and maintenance of NICE’s customer cloud hosted network and security infrastructure, while also resolving customer issues that require direct access to the network and security infrastructure, and acting in an appropriate professional working style

The Specialist Cloud Network Engineer has the following duties:

  1. Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain cooperative working relationships within a global, diverse, multicultural environment.
  2. Ability to work with data center or On premise environment, standing for extended periods of time while performing maintenance duties.
  3. Position may be required to work at a computer terminal and desk for long periods of time on projects.
  4. Network and security administration tasks using industry-standard network equipment and software.
  5. Experience operating and maintaining network devices and security products like Palo Alto, Cisco, F5, and other industry-leading network hardware and software.
  6. Experience deploying and supporting IP networks and associated network technologies.
  7. Establishing, configuring & troubleshooting VPN tunnel related works.
  8. Deep understanding on IPSEC protocol, the TCP/IP stack, how a layer 7 FW processes packets. SSL protocol
  9. Ability to write Terraform scripts and good knowledge in GIT is a plus.
  10. Design and testing of network and security infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPN, WAN and other support systems.
  11. Familiarity with Internet and WAN communications technologies, protocols, and best practices.
  12. Minimum 3 Year of Experience with AWS Cloud & managing AWS network stacks is a mandatory.
  13. Minimum 3 Year of Experience with Palo Alto is mandatory.
  14. AWS and Palo Alto Certification is mandatory.
  15. Configuring & troubleshooting URL related works.

Qualifications:

  1. Advanced English proficiency (B2 or Higher)
  2. A minimum of 3 Years of experience in managing Network & Security Infrastructure and administration of associated software and tools.
  3. Demonstrated ability to work with different security appliances like Palo Alto, Cisco firewalls for ACL, NAT, VPN and other technical assistance.
  4. Demonstrated ability to resolve complex technical issues. Encouraging free and open exchange of technical ideas and suggestions and working with regional and global management to implement approved projects.
  5. Demonstrated ability to install and deploy network routers, firewalls, switches, and other support systems as needed to support corporate and hosted capacity, performance, security, or product functionality requirements.
  6. Experience implementing and supporting a production multi-tenant architecture
  7. Demonstrated ability to prepare, review, test, and deploy network configuration and security software to perform administrative tasks as assigned.
  8. Ability to act as part of NICE Infrastructure Cloud Operations, continuously sharing information and assisting on tasks with other team members.
  9. Ability to provide excellent and ongoing support to other NICE business teams as needed to solve customer and product issues in a timely manner.
  10. Demonstrated ability to deal directly with internal and external customers in a friendly, supportive manner to troubleshoot and solve complex technical issues regarding NICE hosted performance, security, availability, and reliability
  11. Ability to work with or understanding of URL deployments and troubleshooting
  12. Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or other technical discipline or equivalent experience.
  13. PaloAlto Certification.
  14. AWS Certifications.

Additional Information:

This is a Hybrid model position in Bogotá Sutherland's Facilities at Torre Krystal (Cra 7 #156-10, Usaquén)

job.title: Devops Engineer
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 38 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

NICE is looking for a talented Cloud DevOps & Applications Operations Engineer interested in delivering the latest in Application Operations (SaaS) using AWS

At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're seeking highly skilled DevOps to build and operate end-to-end IaC in AWS for our product portfolio. The ideal candidate is comfortable across the entire stack — from responsive front-end interfaces and robust back-end services to databases, networking, and cloud deployment.

As a DevOps application engineer you will be responsible to design scalable APIs and data models, automate infrastructure and deployments, and collaborate closely with development, product support, and operations teams to deliver secure, reliable, high-performing software in the NiCE Cloud.

How will you make an impact?

  • Programing skills: Design and build responsive front-end interfaces and scalable back-end services and APIs, delivering features end to end.
  • Cloud Management: Leverage AWS services (EC2, IAM, RDS, S3, EBS, CloudWatch) to design and manage application infrastructure, ensuring high availability, security, and performance.
  • Infrastructure Automation: Implement and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, and containerized workloads using Kubernetes and Helm for scalable, reliable deployments.
  • Database Engineering: Design, deploy, and optimize relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, or Aurora (including AWS RDS); write and tune queries, manage backups, and resolve performance issues.
  • Scripting & Automation: Write and maintain Python (and PowerShell/Perl where relevant) scripts to automate build, deployment, and operational tasks, integrating tools and services.
  • Configuration Management: Use Ansible to automate configuration management, software deployment, and orchestration across environments.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Implement monitoring and logging (e.g. CloudWatch) to ensure the health of applications and infrastructure, and troubleshoot issues across the stack as they arise.
  • Networking & Security Awareness: Apply a working understanding of IP networking, TCP/IP, VPN, firewalls, and SSL to build and secure cloud-hosted applications.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with development, product support, and operations teams to ensure smooth deployment and operation of applications.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure that application code, infrastructure, and deployment processes comply with industry security standards and best practices.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of total experience, with 3+ years of hands-on DevOps & IaC  (and/or other major languages such as python, c# JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Perl).
  • Proven experience building full stack web applications — front-end frameworks plus back-end services and RESTful APIs.
  • In-depth knowledge of AWS services and best practices for cloud architecture and management.
  • Experience managing AWS infrastructure using Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration and container deployments using Helm.
  • Application deployment and configuration management using Ansible.
  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, or Aurora) and AWS RDS, including backups, restores, and performance tuning.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix systems (RHEL, Amazon Linux); Windows server familiarity is a plus.
  • Working understanding of networking and security concepts (TCP/IP, VPN/IPSec, firewalls, SSL) for cloud-hosted, multi-tenant architectures.
  • Experience providing 24x7 support to production SaaS infrastructure, including on-call rotation and out-of-hours support when needed.
  • Understanding of ITIL processes — incidents, service requests, and change management.
  • B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech/M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience.
  • Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) are a strong plus.
  • Proven ability to learn new technologies quickly and work effectively within a distributed, global team.
  • Detail-oriented and task-driven, with excellent communication skills and a strong customer-service focus.
  • Ability to work in a high-pressure, highly flexible environment against both short- and long-term objectives.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.title: Director - Research
job.description:
Company Description:

Account Management Lead – Research & Financial Markets

Sutherland’s Research & Financial Markets division drives high-impact transformation agenda to address our clients’ most complex business issues - from digital transformation and strategic cost management to operating model redesign, research enablement, analytics, automation, and managed service delivery.

Typical client segments include Investment Banks, Asset Management firms, Private Equity firms, Pension Funds, Sovereign Wealth Funds, Sell-side Research firms, large Corporates, and other Financial Markets institutions.

Sutherland Research has made significant investments in building differentiated solutions that help Financial Institutions reimagine how research, analytics, investment operations, portfolio monitoring, reporting, data management, and decision-support functions are delivered. Our solutions combine domain expertise, global delivery capability, AI-enabled workflows, and operating discipline to help clients improve efficiency, scalability, quality, and insight generation.

Our teams help clients architect future-state operating models, enhance service operations, expand research and analytics capacity, and maximize value from Sutherland’s engagement.

Job Description:

Reporting to the Business Head for Financial Markets, key responsibilities include:

► Manage and grow a portfolio of named Financial Markets accounts across Investment Banking, Asset Management, Private Equity, Pension Funds, and large Corporates
► Own account-level revenue targets, with responsibility for expansion, renewals, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities within specified accounts
► Develop deep client relationships across Research, Strategy, Investment Operations, Data, Analytics, Finance, and CXO-level stakeholders
► Identify new opportunities within existing accounts by understanding client priorities, operating challenges, budget cycles, and transformation agendas
► Generate new leads through disciplined outreach, referrals, client mapping, industry research, thought leadership follow-up, and relationship-led prospecting
► Build account plans for key clients, including stakeholder maps, current engagement footprint, whitespace opportunities, competitor presence, and growth strategy
► Position Sutherland’s high-end professional services across Investment Research, Portfolio Monitoring, Market Research, ESG Research, Investment Reporting, Automation, & Analytics
► Collaborate with Sales, Delivery, Solutioning, Research Leadership, and offshore subject matter experts to shape relevant client propositions
► Support proposal development, commercial discussions, pricing inputs, solution design, and contract renewal processes
► Deliver high-quality pitches and business reviews to senior stakeholders
► Maintain a disciplined account management cadence, including pipeline tracking, opportunity follow-up, CRM hygiene, revenue forecasting, and client touchpoint planning
► Ensure client satisfaction by proactively identifying service issues, escalation risks, delivery gaps, and opportunities to improve engagement quality
► Partner with delivery teams to ensure Sutherland is viewed as a strategic partner
► Support marketing and dissemination of thought leadership at various industry forums
► Travel as required for client meetings, account reviews, industry events, etc

Qualifications:

I. Candidate will possess strong account management and sales capabilities with a minimum of 6 - 10 years of progressive experience in account management, business development, enterprise sales, or client relationship management

II. Graduate degree required; Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline preferred

III. Should possess strong understanding of Financial Markets, including Investment Banking, Asset Management, Private Equity, Sell-side Research, Investment Operations, and Research & Analytics services

IV. Should have experience managing named accounts, developing account plans, identifying whitespace opportunities, and growing revenue within existing client relationships

V. Should be commercially astute, financially literate, and comfortable discussing research, analytics, data, reporting, and managed services with senior client stakeholders

VI. Experience selling or managing professional services, research services, offshoring, outsourcing, analytics, data management, or financial services solutions is highly desirable

VII. Should have a strong client service orientation with the ability to build trusted, long-term relationships across multiple stakeholder levels

VIII. Must possess strong sales discipline, including pipeline creation, opportunity qualification, revenue forecasting, proposal coordination, and follow-through

IX. Strong presentation, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders at Head of Function and CXO levels

X. Previous experience in a front-office, research, investment operations, consulting, or financial services environment will be an added advantage

Our client delivers the world’s most personal travel experiences. We bring to life each client’s desire to travel in a way that’s tailored specifically for them, in the company of local private guides who ensure that they enjoy the authentic best of their destination. The result is a unique journey rich in memories that last a lifetime!

We achieve this because of our extraordinary people, passionate experts with deep knowledge of their destinations. They are what enables us to deliver remarkable experiences in over 120 countries worldwide, and across each of our businesses – Private Touring, Cruises, Villas, Yachts, Expeditions, Ultraluxe Land, Private Jets, and Air. 

We’re looking for an experienced professional with a passion for travel and strong sales acumen. In this full-cycle consultative sales role, you will guide prospective clients from the first discovery call to post-travel follow-up - turning interest into commitment, and bookings into lifelong relationships.

job.title: AVP - CDE, Manufacturing
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is a digital transformation company focused on delivering exceptional experiences for both customers and employees. For 38 years, we have been entrusted with caring for our clients’ customers - a responsibility we believe we should earn every day. We are dedicated to making those experiences as delightful as possible - instantaneous, relevant, predictive, and frictionless. As an early pioneer in robotic automation, we added to our core through steady investment and acquiring key capabilities. Our design capabilities marry human insight, design- thinking, and process engineering. To make these designs come to life as envisioned by our designers, we employ the latest in robotic automation, conversational AI techniques with a range of AI-ML enhanced products and cloud-based platforms.

We believe that the best relationships come from trust and value. In addition to delivering exceptionally engineered experiences, we help our clients improve their productivity, reduce costs, enhance customer loyalty, build additional revenues, reduce time-to-market, and efficiently enter new markets. We also stand by our results. Sixty-one percent of our business is outcome based, ensuring our success is clearly tied to our clients’ success. We think that is simple for our clients to understand, and it adds to trust and transparency. Today, over 60 percent of our revenues come from clients with us for more than 11 years. Forty percent of our revenues come from Fortune-50, and 56 percent from Fortune-500 clients.

Though we have a rich history, our sights are anchored deeply in the future. We are optimistic about the benefits industry and society will see as human–machine collaboration continues to enhance what people can do. Our offerings deliver on this whether they are Sutherland Anywhere, enabling a secure remote work environment or Sutherland Connect, delivering data- rich, omni-channel services. Our deep product and platform expertise is trained on solving human problems before they emerge, and on how we wrap services around them - hiring, training, performance, security and more - to solve problems for our clients from end to end.  We work with clients across industries, including Banking, Financial Services and Insurance, Healthcare, Retail, Telecommunications, Media & Entertainment, and Technology, as well as Travel, Hospitality and Logistics.

Our digital backbone spans 144 countries around the world, with 61 delivery centers across 19 countries, handling over 43 million transactions a month for approximately 70 clients. We are a team of 38,000 global professionals, operationally effective, culturally meshed, and committed to our clients and to one another. We call it One Sutherland.

 

Job Description:

The CDE is responsible for selling Sutherland offerings to new logo Manufacturing accounts where Sutherland presently has no relationships.  The CDE drives new logo revenues through relationship development, quality delivery and execution of all engagement that drive organic growth and strong relationships.

An ideal CDE is passionate about developing and driving new client relationships and can successfully interact with senior executive level clients. This individual manages new revenue development and can lead complex multi-dimensional engagements that combine digital, consulting, and large technology deployments. This person is a high-energy leader with the ability to grow client relationships through presenting new strategies and innovative ideas. 

 

Additional information

Key Result Areas (KRAs):

  • Profitable Growth - Accountability of total growth in the account including R&G accountability. Expand Digital penetration.
  • Executive Relationship Management - Nurturing existing relationships with the goal to keep / turn stakeholders into advocates, with increased focus on Expanding CXO relationships. Continued high NPS.
  • Proactive Value Creation, Innovation - Value creation and demonstration in existing engagements. Strategic Alignment with Client’s agenda and building executive cadence to continually discuss value.
  • Thought Leadership, Trusted Advisor - Be the Trusted Advisor your client calls for advice and ideas. Cross Industry sessions give our TIG thought leaders the stage in front of the clients.
  • Hands on Leadership - Ensuring contractual commitments are met. Proactively addressing issues that may arise in service delivery.
  • Champion transformation initiatives within the accounts

Qualifications:

Qualifications

  • Direct business development and sales activities with new relationships within a set of base accounts
  • Build and maintain a pipeline of 5X of in year revenue target.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities which equate to a $3M ACV total and/or $1M ACV digital deal profile.
  • Deliver assigned in year revenue target ranging from $4-10+M; while meeting company EBITDA targets.
  • Establish and maintain consultative sales relationships within each prospective client organization and constantly look to meet new buyers within our clients’ organization
  • Identify opportunities to offer value through our new strategic services
  • Thoroughly understand the client’s business, both strategic and tactical, including themes and underlying issues, and align Sutherland’s current and future capabilities to create client opportunities and solve business problems
  • Sell across the suite of services, including digital transformation, IT, customer engagement, and business process transformation services
  • Leverage Manufacturing domain expertise, technical, digital and operational knowledge to create demand and persuade prospective clients through the development and presentation of compelling value propositions and purchasing rationales
  • Accountable for the client relationship from deal conception to closing
  • Use financial acumen to position a value proposition for the client, as well as financial soundness for the organization, making the client confident in their choice to grow with Sutherland 

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

EEOC and Veteran Documentation
During employment, employees are treated without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or handicap, or any other legally protected status.
At times, government agencies require periodic reports from employers on the sex, ethnicity, handicap, veteran and other protected status of employees. The purpose of this Administrative EEO Record is for statistical analysis only and is used to comply with government record keeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Periodic reports are made to the government on the following information. The completion of the Administrative EEO record is optional. If you choose to volunteer the requested information, please note that all 
Administrative EEO Records are kept in a Confidential File and are not part of your Application for Employment or Personnel file.
Please note: YOUR COOPERATION IS VOLUNTARY. INCLUSION OR EXCLUSION OF ANY DATA WILL NOT AFFECT ANY EMPLOYMENT DECISION.

job.title: Practicante Área de Nómina
job.description:
Descripción de la empresa:

¡Somos una comunidad global de más de 40.000 personas en más de 20 países que creemos en hacer las cosas con excelencia y corazón! 💙

Nos especializamos en brindar soluciones de experiencia al cliente (CX), tecnología y transformación digital a algunas de las marcas más reconocidas del mundo. En Colombia, hemos crecido con fuerza, y somos reconocidos por ofrecer un ambiente inclusivo, dinámico y lleno de oportunidades para crecer desde cero. 🚀

Aquí valoramos el talento joven: creemos que con buena actitud, ganas de aprender y compromiso, puedes construir una gran carrera profesional. 💼✨

Únete a un equipo donde se trabaja duro, se aprende todos los días y también se disfruta el camino. ¡En Sutherland tu voz cuenta!

Descripción del empleo:

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un estudiante en etapa de práctica que desee iniciar su carrera profesional en el área de Nómina. Esta posición es ideal para personas proactivas, organizadas y con interés en adquirir conocimientos en los procesos administrativos y operativos relacionados con la gestión del talento humano y la liquidación de nómina.

Responsabilidades:

  • Apoyar en el proceso de liquidación de nómina, seguridad social y prestaciones sociales.

  • Colaborar en la recopilación y verificación de novedades de personal.

  • Ayudar en la actualización de bases de datos y expedientes de empleados.

  • Brindar soporte en la atención a colaboradores respecto a temas relacionados con pagos y beneficios.

  • Participar en actividades administrativas del área de Talento Humano.

Requisitos:

  • Estudiante activo de carreras como Administración de Empresas, Contaduría Publica, Gestión Humana, o afines.

  • Contar con aval de la universidad para realizar práctica profesional.

  • Manejo básico de Excel.

  • Buena actitud, disposición para aprender y trabajo en equipo.

Información adicional:

  • Nos comprometemos a fomentar un entorno laboral diverso, equitativo e inclusivo donde todos los empleados y candidatos sean tratados con respeto y tengan igualdad de oportunidades laborales, independientemente de su raza, color, religión, sexo, origen nacional, edad, estado civil, discapacidad, condición de veterano o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

    En ocasiones, las agencias gubernamentales solicitan informes periódicos a los empleadores sobre el sexo, la etnia, la discapacidad, la condición de veterano y otras condiciones protegidas de los empleados. El propósito de este Registro Administrativo de Igualdad de Oportunidades en el Empleo (EEO) es únicamente el análisis estadístico y se utiliza para cumplir con los requisitos gubernamentales de registro, presentación de informes y demás obligaciones legales.
