Level 3: 4 years to 7 years

Location: Chennai, India (Mandatory Work from Office)
Shift: US Night Shift (5 Days a Week)

Role #1

US Payroll - Level 2 & Level 3

We are seeking an experienced Senior Payroll Specialist / Lead to serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for US payroll operations. This role is responsible for ensuring compliant, accurate, and efficient payroll delivery while driving continuous improvement initiatives. The position offers exposure to complex multi-state payroll, global governance, advanced system operations, and leadership opportunities.

The Lead will additionally review and validate pre-payroll inputs, analyze payroll outputs, administer post-payroll activities, mentor junior specialists, and ensure adherence to SLAs/KPIs. This role requires night shift support with rotational weekly offs and is based out of our Chennai office.

 

Role #2

Payroll Tax Analyst – Level 3

We are looking for a detail-oriented Payroll Tax Analyst with strong experience in US Payroll Tax and multi-state payroll operations.

Key Responsibilities:

• Manage end-to-end payroll tax processing & reconciliations

• Prepare/review Federal, State & Local tax filings (941, 940, W-2, W-2C)

• Handle tax notices, amendments & compliance deadlines

• Support year-end payroll tax activities

• Drive process improvements & stakeholder coordination

 

What We’re Looking For:

• 4+ years of Payroll / Payroll Tax experience

• Strong knowledge of US payroll tax regulations

• Experience in multi-state payroll environment

• Hands-on with ADP, Workday or similar payroll tools

• Strong Excel & analytical skills

 

Role #3

Benefits Administration - Level 1

We are looking for a highly detail-oriented and dependable Compensation Specialist to join our HR Shared Services team in Chennai. This role plays a critical part in ensuring accurate and compliant administration of compensation and benefits processes for the US region. The specialist will work extensively with Workday Compensation modules, support annual compensation cycles, maintain data accuracy, and deliver exceptional employee experience through timely and precise operations.

This is a work-from-office, night-shift role with rotational weekly offs.

Benefits Administration - Level 2

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Senior Compensation Specialist to support and enhance US compensation and benefits operations. This role serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for compensation processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution of compensation programs. The Senior Associate will focus on executing compensation cycles and managing complex data validations.

The ideal candidate possesses deep knowledge of US compensation regulations, hands-on experience with Workday Compensation, strong analytical capability, and a commitment to operational excellence. This role requires working night shifts with rotational weekly offs and is based out of our Chennai office.

 

Role #4

Compliance & Incident Management – Hotline Support

Level 1

The L1 Hotline Support role is responsible for being the first point of contact for compliance and incident-related queries received via hotline, email, or ticketing tools. The individual will take calls, capture accurate information, create incidents, and route requests as per defined SOPs.

Level 2

The L2 Hotline Support role handles complex hotline interactions, performs advanced triage, validates incident details, and ensures correct categorization, prioritization, and resolution routing. The role also supports quality checks, coaching of L1 resources, and escalation management.

Level 3

We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented, and compliance-focused Lead – Compliance & Incident Management (L3) to support US HR Shared Services operations. This role serves as a subject matter expert (SME) for US HR compliance, incident governance, documentation integrity, and audit readiness. The Lead is responsible for resolving complex cases, supporting investigations, guiding team members, and ensuring adherence to federal and state regulations.

 

Talent Management - Level 2 & Level 3

  • We are seeking an experienced Senior Talent Management Specialist / Lead to serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for US Talent programs, supporting end-to-end execution of Talent cycles, Workday configuration, and operational governance. This role ensures seamless execution of performance management, succession planning, talent data integrity, and recruitment support processes.
  • The Lead will additionally oversee candidate screening and background verification (BGV) workflows, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and professional handling of sensitive information. This role also requires mentoring junior specialists, managing escalations, and driving continuous improvement initiatives across Talent Operations. This position supports US time zones, requires night shift work with rotational weekly offs, and is based in our Chennai office.

Role #4

HR Administration

Level 1

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and motivated HR Operations Specialist to join our high-performing HR Shared Services (HRSS) team supporting the US region. This role is essential in ensuring accurate execution of core HR processes, maintaining compliance, and delivering a seamless employee experience.

The ideal candidate brings strong operational discipline, foundational knowledge of US HR practices, and the ability to support recruitment operations while collaborating effectively across teams.

Level 2

We are seeking experienced and highly capable Senior HR Operations Specialists to drive delivery excellence within our high-performing HR Shared Services (HRSS) organization supporting the US market. This role requires deep subject matter expertise in HR processes, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to ensure compliance with US labor laws and regulatory standards.

The Senior Associate will manage core HR processes and employee support. This role requires night shift support with rotational weekly offs and is based out of our Chennai office.

job.title: Cloud Support Engineer
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 39 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

Job Description:

Sutherland is seeking a Cloud Support Engineer to play a key role in supporting, monitoring, and maintaining enterprise cloud-based applications and production environments. This role requires a strong technical background in application support, cloud operations, troubleshooting, and production environment management. The ideal candidate will work closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Customer Support, and cross-functional teams to ensure the stability, availability, and performance of mission-critical systems.

The Cloud Support Engineer performs a wide range of duties including some or all the following:

  • Monitor, maintain, and support cloud-hosted applications and production environments to ensure high availability and optimal performance.
  • Perform operational activities including application health monitoring, service management, server maintenance, and environment support.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve operational issues related to applications, infrastructure, data pipelines, integrations, batch processing, and network connectivity.
  • Monitor server performance metrics including CPU utilization, memory consumption, databases, file systems, application services, and scheduled jobs.
  • Review, prioritize, and resolve production incidents and support requests while maintaining service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for application, infrastructure, database, and operational issues.
  • Maintain operational documentation including runbooks, troubleshooting guides, incident records, and support procedures.
  • Generate operational reports, production metrics, status updates, and environment health dashboards.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Infrastructure teams to optimize application reliability, scalability, and deployment processes.
  • Support on-call rotations and provide off-hours support when required to maintain production availability.

Qualifications:

  • Advanced English proficiency (B2 or Higher)
  • 2+ years of experience supporting production environments, cloud operations, application support, infrastructure support, or related technical roles.
  • Experience supporting cloud-hosted environments and familiarity with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Hands-on experience working with Unix/Linux environments, Windows servers, shell scripting, SSH, and application server management.
  • Experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or similar technologies.
  • Understanding of application monitoring, troubleshooting, debugging, performance optimization, and scalability concepts.
  • Familiarity with data flows, ETL processes, integrations, and distributed application environments.
  • Knowledge of application security best practices, fault detection, incident management, and operational processes.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues quickly.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with customers, technical teams, and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in fast-paced production environments.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and support non-prime shift operations when required.

Additional Information:

Hybrid work model: 3 days working from home and 2 days onsite at our Torre Krystal offices in Bogotá.

Overview

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Technical Customer Support Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in payments, transaction processing, and customer service, with a passion for payments. In this role, you will be the key point of contact for both internal teams and clients internal teams and clients, providing timely, effective solutions to technical issues, driving customer satisfaction, and contributing to process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Customer/Client Centricity

  • Be a named point of contact and take ownership of service for a group of Thredd clients, ensuring their needs are met with high standards of service.
  • Provide second-level analysis, investigation, and resolution for customer service requests related to card/transaction processing, electronic Point of Sale (POS), ATMs, and fraud.
  • Advocate for clients, representing their requirements and needs within the organization to ensure alignment on new features or enhancements.
  • Work closely with internal teams (Customer Care, Tech, and Product) and third parties to address root causes of issues and prevent future occurrences.
  • Ensure clear, timely communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, adapting your approach based on the audience.

Problem-Solving & Incident Management

  • Resolve technical issues related to transaction processing, including fraud, chargebacks, 3DS, and other payment systems.
  • Follow and adhere to incident management procedures, ensuring appropriate escalation, investigation, and communication.

Data & Reporting

  • Provide analysis on card/transaction data, leveraging in-house systems (e.g., SC, EHI, WS, Jira) and external tools (e.g., Postman, ELK, Soap).
  • Develop and present data-driven insights that inform decision-making, product improvements, and customer service enhancements.

Leadership & Team Collaboration

  • Build strong relationships across departments (e.g., IMPS, AM, AS, Product) to foster teamwork and ensure alignment on goals.
  • Support team learning and development, sharing knowledge and best practices.
  • Manage personal performance and goals to drive continuous improvement and ensure successful project outcomes.

Qualifications:

Required Experience:

  • Advanced English proficiency (B2 or Higher)
  • A proven track record of successful technical customer support or client-facing roles, especially in payments, transaction processing, or banking.
  • Deep understanding of transaction systems (card, POS, ATM), fraud prevention (3DS), chargebacks, and payment gateways.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment where client service and quick resolution of issues are critical.
  • Strong technical knowledge of APIs (Soap or REST), SQL, XML/JSON, and familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Postman, ELK, etc.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with an ability to make sound decisions based on good judgement.
  • Experience in data analysis and reporting using tools like Excel or similar.

Desirable Experience:

  • Familiarity with MasterCard/Visa processing, platform functionality, and the impact of regulatory and scheme changes.
  • Exposure to fraud systems, 3DS, and other payment security tools.
  • Experience working in B2B and/or operational support roles, specifically within payments or technology sectors.

Core Skills:

  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills in English, with the ability to adapt language for diverse audiences.
  • Ability to perform effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to problem-solving.
  • Time management skills with a strong sense of urgency and the ability to prioritise workloads effectively.

Associates should educate customers on account status, attempting to solve customer problems and/or attempting to secure a payment or make payment arrangements. The goal is to help our customers build and retain a strong credit standing and maintain a customer for life.

  • Passionate and goal-oriented
  • Positive emotional resilience and emotional intelligence.
  • Must be self-motivated with strong decision-making and problem solving abilities

  •  A minimum of 3-4 CXC/GCE/City & Guilds subjects inclusive of English Language, or a U.S. high school diploma or GED. (CXC/CSEC, City & Guilds. I, II, III; GCE A, B, C; SSC 4, 5; JSCE Pass; NCTVET Level 1, 2, 3; and CCSLC Competence & Mastery).
  • Must have a valid (not expired) government issued ID, TRN and NIS card.

  • Scripting & Automation

  • Windows Deployment & Imaging
    • Microsoft Deployment Toolkit (MDT)
    • Windows ADK, WinPE, WinRE

    • Windows Image development and deployment workflows

job.description:

If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!!

Job Description:

Looking for talented Embedded software System Test Automation engineers to join our R&D-IPT Pune India team. This project is for providing a high quality sterilized medical device platform to other medical products. This role is full onsite at Pune location 5 days in a week.

Job Duties:

As an Sr. Embedded software test automation engineer, you will take ownership of understanding the product functional and low-level requirements, Review of System requirements and System architecture, Develop the software test strategies, test plans, test protocols and test cases for integration, module, and functional testing. Executing the test cases and Provide status of test results, Report and root cause all issues discovered and drive them to close. Document the embedded medical software products test life cycle artifacts. You will partner with global product development and test teams to ensure deliver the high-quality products.

Requirements expertise and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree with 5+ years of professional work experience with system engineering and Embedded software test life cycle.
  • Expertise in Software validation and verification for Embedded software products, RTOS platforms or RT-Linux Platforms or Multi-threaded environment.
  • Experience with 32-bit microcontroller and microprocess (ARM or RISC-V platforms).
  • Experience with UART, I2C, SPI, CAN communications and Analog and Digital Input Outputs testing
  • Experience with Linux based HMI device testing and Linux shell scripting.
  • Hands on work with Software test frameworks, Creating test scripts for automated verification tests.
  • Ability to work with the Hardware test simulators or Hardware test setup and troubleshoot the Hardware test setup using multi-meter and Scope.
  • Experience with Flashing tools, debuggers and analyse the debug logs.
  • Experience with software tools for requirements management tools, Bug Tracking tools and Version control tools.

Must to have:

  • Experience in Embedded C or C++.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python with experience in test automation tools.

Soft Skills:

job.title: Implementation Engineer (Cisco/Omnichannel CX) -CONNECT
job.description:
Company Description:

We are One Sutherland — a global team where everyone is working together to create great breakthrough solutions. Our workforce has thrived in an environment of diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate our diversity and embrace it whole-heartedly. Sutherland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote a positive work environment by conducting ourselves professionally and helping each other achieve our goal of One Sutherland Team, Playing to Win.

Sutherland was founded 35 years ago (1986). Since then, we have become a leading global provider of business process and technology management services offering an integrated portfolio of analytics-driven back office and customer-facing solutions that support the entire customer life cycle.

 

Job Description:

  1. Responsible for the design, implementation and support of Sutherland CISCO UCCE and CUCM platforms.  Current platforms include Cisco ICM, CUBE, CISCO Call Studio, CVP, Omni-Channel solutions such as  Cisco Routing, Inbound Voice, , Cisco Email, Cisco Chat, Cisco Social Media, CISCO SMS, Speech Analytics, Proactive Contact, CallBack, Outbound campaign Manager etc.
  2. Strong Knowledge in CISCO UCCE , WEBEX Connect and Java
  3. Responsible for working closely with the partnering groups within Sutherland to gather business requirements and ensure that our technical offering satisfies those requirements.  
  4. Partners with the Business and Service Delivery team to assist with new Program solutions. 
  5. Responsible for Engineering design documentation along with Runbooks for Operations.
  6. Partners with development/integrations team for platform support when needed.
  7. Develop monitoring solutions to provide proactive monitoring capabilities for the Infrastructure team and utilize these metrics to continue the evolution of the infrastructure.
  8. Conduct testing and develop disaster recovery plans to detect faults, minimize malfunctions, and backup systems.
  9. Provide highest level of technical consultancy to ensure problem resolution is achieved in the shortest possible timeframe
  10. Manages vendors on escalated issues and projects specific to your area of influence.
  11. Interacts directly with client related to issues, problems, or overall design.
  12. Mentors Engineers and IT Solutions Technicians on infrastructure related to area of influence for proper transition to Operations team for platform support.
  13. Willingness and ability to cross train others in the varying technologies related to area of influence.
  14. Design and lead the implementation of Infrastructure architecture based on enterprise business requirements and IT Strategies.

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have:

  • BS in Computer Science, Engineering or related field or 6 - 8 years progressive relevant experience required.

  • Expert knowledge of CISCO UCCE  and CUCM Platform
  • Expert in creating CISCO eServices (Email, Chat, SMS or Social Media) routing strategies from scratch
  • At least 2 years of experience on Java Elements
  • 5 years demonstrated experience delivering on multiple, simultaneous projects.
  • 5 years’ experience with vendor management and performance to ensure compliance with commitments and budget.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking a reliable and technical person to join us as Embedded Software Developer (C++) who will play a key role in driving our continued product growth and innovation. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!!

Job Description:

Duties

  • Identify inconsistencies and formulate solutions to complex and ambiguous technical problems.
  • Develop & implements (write C++ code),  software designs according to architecture that meet defined product specifications.
  • Propose solutions and technical direction for future development efforts.
  • Use appropriate design principles to ensure robust, maintainable software applications.
  • Provide in-depth design reviews to ensure designs can meet product’s functional and performance requirements.
  • Mentor junior engineers to propagate good design principles and development practices throughout the team.
  • Investigate new software technologies and tools and appropriate application.
  • Ensure software architecture, design, and interface specifications comply with department guidelines and can fulfil requirements.

    Required Experience

    • 8 years of progressive experience in the design, development, and implementation of embedded Windows and/or Linux based software systems utilizing both structured and object-oriented concepts using C++.
    • Six or more years of experience in design and implementation of multi-tasking and multi-threaded systems.
    • Demonstrated technical expert within a software development organization.
    • Understanding of development for a resource-constrained target environment with specific performance requirements..
    • Experience in development using various operating systems, including real-time operating systems (RTOS), such as ThreadX, RTXC, Linux, Windows (standard or embedded).
    • Knowledge of YOCTO or BSP development for ARM platform.
    • Demonstrated knowledge of Internet of Things (IoT) and associated solutions is desired, e.g., remote monitoring solutions.
    • Knowledge and experience with standard communication and network protocols.

    Preferred Experience

    • Advanced degree in Engineering or related field desired
    • Engineering experience within a highly regulated industry
    • Certification or training coursework in software security
    • 4+ years’ experience of software development in C, Modern C++highly desirable
    • 1+ years’ experience in network communication interfaces desirable
    • Experience performing risk assessments desirable.
    • Experience with formal design and requirement tools is desirable.
    • Experience with assessing cybersecurity risks and designing appropriate mitigations is highly preferred.

  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with RESTful service design
  • Knowledge of microservices or cloud platforms (Azure/AWS)
  • Exposure to CI/CD tools and DevOps practices
  • Knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3

job.title: Embedded System Software Test Engineer
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking a reliable and technical person to join us as Embedded System Software Test Engineer who will play a key role in driving our continued product growth and innovation. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!!

Job Description:

Looking for talented Embedded software System Test engineers to join our R&D-IPT Pune India team. This project is for providing a high quality sterilized medical device platform to other medical products. This role is full onsite at Pune location 5 days in a week.

Job Duties:

As an Sr. Embedded software test engineer, you will take ownership of understanding the product functional and low-level requirements, Review of System requirements and System architecture, Develop the software test strategies, test plans, test protocols and test cases for integration, module, and functional testing. Executing the test cases and Provide status of test results, Report and root cause all issues discovered and drive them to close. Document the embedded medical software products test life cycle artifacts. You will partner with global product development and test teams to ensure deliver the high-quality products.

Requirements expertise and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree with 4+ years of professional work experience with system engineering and Embedded software test life cycle.
  • Expertise in Software validation and verification for Embedded software products, RTOS platforms or RT-Linux Platforms or Multi-threaded environment.
  • Experience with 32-bit microcontroller and microprocess (ARM or RISC-V platforms).
  • Experience with UART, I2C, SPI, CAN communications and Analog and Digital Input Outputs testing
  • Experience with Linux based HMI device testing and Linux shell scripting.
  • Hands on work with Software test frameworks, Creating test scripts for automated verification tests.
  • Ability to work with the Hardware test simulators or Hardware test setup and troubleshoot the Hardware test setup using multi-meter and Scope.
  • Experience with Flashing tools, debuggers and analyse the debug logs.
  • Experience with software tools for requirements management tools, Bug Tracking tools and Version control tools.

Good to have:

  • Experience in embedded C or C++ , Scripting languages such as python and Automating testing tools.

Soft Skills:

  • Good team player and ability to work independently and as a part of a team.
  • Ability to handle a constantly changing set of priorities.
  • Good Communication and Documentation skills.
  • Flexible to work with global team times.

 

Qualifications:

job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland: 

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

Sutherland

Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results

Job Description:

We are looking for an experienced SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) Consultant with strong coding experience and a solid understanding of SAP's cloud technologies. The ideal candidate should have 10-12 years of hands-on coding experience, including at least 2 years of focused experience with SAP BTP. Candidate must have experience with one full life cycle implementation on S/4HANA Public Cloud.  

 
Key Responsibilities: 

1. SAP BTP Development and Implementation: 

  • Lead and participate in the design, development, and deployment of applications on SAP BTP. 
  • Utilize SAP BTP services such as SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) Model, SAP Business Application Studio, and SAP Integration Suite to develop scalable solutions. 
  • Engage in one full life cycle implementation project, preferably on S/4HANA Public Cloud. 

 

2. Coding and Custom Development: 

  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using Java, Node.js, or other relevant languages. 
  • Develop custom applications and extensions on SAP BTP, integrating them with existing SAP systems. 
  • Utilize SAP BTP’s multicloud and platform-as-a-service capabilities for developing advanced solutions. 

3. Cloud Integration and Extension: 

  • Design and implement integrations between SAP BTP and other SAP or non-SAP systems. 
  • Use SAP Cloud Integration, SAP API Management, and SAP Extension Suite to extend and integrate enterprise applications. 
  • Develop and manage APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications on SAP BTP. 

4. Project Management: 

  • Collaborate with project managers to ensure successful delivery of SAP BTP projects, including planning, execution, and monitoring. 
  • Manage project risks and issues, ensuring timely resolution and mitigation. 

5. Innovation and Solution Design: 

  • Lead workshops and design sessions with business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions using SAP BTP. 
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest SAP BTP technologies, and drive innovation by proposing new tools and approaches to enhance business processes. 

6. Documentation and Reporting: 

  • Create comprehensive technical documentation, including design documents, coding standards, and user manuals. 
  • Provide regular status updates and reports to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment on project progress. 

7. Support and Maintenance: 

  • Provide ongoing support for SAP BTP applications, resolving technical issues and ensuring optimal performance. 
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of applications on SAP BTP, ensuring scalability and reliability. 

 

Requirement:

  • 10-12 years of coding experience with a strong background in enterprise application development. 
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with SAP BTP, including development and integration. 
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, or Python. 
  • Experience with SAP BTP services like SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) Model, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Extension Suite. 
  • Experience with at least one full life cycle implementation, preferably on S/4HANA Public Cloud. 
  • Strong understanding of cloud computing principles, microservices architecture, and API management. 
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to design and implement complex solutions. 
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross-functional teams. 

 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • SAP BTP certification. 
  • Experience with DevOps tools and practices (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, containerization). 
  • Knowledge of SAP Fiori, SAP UI5, and SAP Mobile Services. 
  • Experience with agile methodologies and project management tools. 

 

Additional Information:

 

  • SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud certification. 

  • Experience with SAP Fiori and other S/4HANA front-end tools. 

  • Knowledge of global sales processes and distribution regulations. 

  • Experience in the public sector or with public cloud environments. 

tion will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.description:
Company Description:

About Sutherland: 

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

Sutherland

Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities:

  • SAP BTP Integration Design & Implementation:
    • Lead the design, development, and implementation of end-to-end integration solutions leveraging SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) to enable seamless data flow across SAP and third-party systems.
    • Develop and manage integrations using SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, and SAP Cloud Platform Integration), SAP PI/PO, and SAP Data Intelligence.
    • Build and manage integrations between SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP SuccessFactors, and other cloud and on-premise applications, ensuring smooth communication and data exchange.
  • Enterprise Integration Focus:
    • Architect and implement scalable enterprise integration solutions that connect SAP systems with a range of enterprise applications, both cloud-based and on-premise.
    • Ensure integration solutions are designed to meet business requirements for real-time data processing, business intelligence, and operational efficiency.
    • Utilize middleware tools and technologies, including SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), SAP PI/PO, and other industry-standard integration platforms.
  • SAP BTP Development:
    • Design and develop custom applications, services, and APIs within SAP BTP to enable business processes and integration workflows.
    • Work with cloud-native tools and technologies (e.g., SAP Cloud Application Programming, SAP HANA Cloud) to build scalable, high-performance applications.
    • Optimize and enhance integration flows and development artifacts to improve system performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Project Management & Delivery:
    • Lead the technical delivery of SAP BTP integration projects, ensuring the project is delivered on time, within budget, and in line with client expectations.
    • Oversee the integration lifecycle, from design and development to testing, deployment, and support.
    • Actively manage project risks, issues, and challenges related to integration, ensuring clear communication with all stakeholders and prompt issue resolution.
    • Collaborate with business, functional, and technical teams to ensure seamless integration of processes across SAP and non-SAP systems.
  • Client Interaction & Requirements Gathering:
    • Engage with business stakeholders and clients to understand enterprise integration needs and define integration requirements.
    • Provide expert guidance on best practices for integration and enterprise architecture, offering recommendations based on business and technical goals.
    • Conduct regular meetings with clients to track project progress, gather feedback, and ensure the integration solution meets business expectations.
  • Continuous Improvement & Innovation:
    • Stay current with the latest SAP BTP technologies, integration strategies, and industry best practices to deliver innovative solutions.
    • Evaluate and recommend new integration tools, platforms, and methodologies to improve integration efficiency and system performance.
    • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, improving integration practices and fostering continuous learning within the team.

Key Skills & Qualifications:

  • Technical Expertise:
    • Extensive experience in SAP BTP Integration, including SAP Integration Suite (CPI), SAP PI/PO, and other integration tools (SAP Data Intelligence, SAP API Management).
    • Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and other SAP modules, with hands-on experience integrating SAP systems with third-party systems.
    • Proficient in cloud-based development technologies, including SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP), SAP HANA Cloud, and SAP Fiori for front-end integration.
    • Solid understanding of enterprise integration concepts, API management, messaging queues, data exchange formats (e.g., JSON, XML), and web services.
  • Experience & Project Delivery:
    • A proven track record of successfully managing and delivering enterprise-level SAP BTP integration projects, with a focus on high-quality, scalable solutions.
    • Strong understanding of integration methodologies and frameworks, including REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures.
    • Expertise in enterprise architecture, cloud integration strategies, and design patterns, particularly for SAP BTP solutions.
  • Problem-Solving & Analytical Skills:
    • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues and provide timely resolutions.
    • Ability to design and optimize integration solutions to meet business and technical requirements, ensuring high system availability and performance.
  • Leadership & Communication:
    • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively with business, functional, and technical stakeholders.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience & Education:
    • Minimum of 9 years of experience in SAP with at least 3 years of hands-on experience in SAP BTP Integration and Development.
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
    • SAP certifications related to SAP BTP, Integration, and Development are highly desirable.

Preferred Additional Skills:

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA cloud implementations or migrations.
  • Knowledge of SAP Business Application Studio, SAP Cloud SDK, or other tools for SAP development in the cloud.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and DevOps practices for continuous integration/delivery (CI/CD).
  • Experience with security and compliance requirements for enterprise integrations (OAuth, SAML, etc.).

Additional Information:

job.title: Marketing Campaign Manager | UK | Hybrid
job.description:
Job Description:

Are you an experienced Field Marketer/Regional Campaign Manager for B2B Digital Transformation organizations? This is a great opportunity to drive growth in key regions for Sutherland!

Open to candidates based in the London, UK area but open to anywhere in Europe!  

Sutherland is seeking a Manager/Senior Manager, Marketing Campaigns to develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns that drive qualified pipeline and ROI across the priority European regions. This role is both strategic and execution-focused, requiring the skillset to build the long-term vision for multi-touch customer journeys along with the day-to-day operations of running multiple campaigns tailored to regional buying behaviors and performance KPIs. You’re a fit for this role if you are passionate about accelerating revenue, comfortable rolling up your sleeves, and have a strong bias to data-driven action. Success in this position will be measured by significant contributions to sales pipeline growth, efficient marketing ROI, and the elevation of Sutherland’s brand awareness in target markets.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Plan, craft, execute and manage integrated marketing campaigns to increase awareness and generate qualified leads in priority Europe markets.
  • Localize messaging and campaign tactics to regional buyer behaviors, regulations (e.g. GDPR), market expectations and language.
  • Benchmark competitors in-region and incorporate insights into campaigns.
  • Align closely with regional sales, industry marketing leaders translate GTM goals into action.
  • Manage campaign types including email, organic social, webinars, events, etc.
  • Integrate ABM practices into campaign approach. Personalize messaging using intent data and region-specific personas.
  • Oversee campaign execution and cross-functional coordination across time zones.
  • Recommend region-specific innovation in tactics, partnerships, or media.

Channel & Tactic Optimization

  • Optimize performance by tracking regional channel mix effectiveness.
  • Conduct A/B tests across content formats and targeting methods tailored to regional segments.

Event & Webinar Execution

  • Lead and support Europe-based field events, roundtables, and webinars.
  • Coordinate promotion, logistics, localization, and speaker prep.

Content Creation

  • Leverage insights into European buyer pain points and cultural nuances to develop or adapt content that resonates with regional audiences.
  • Write short-form content including blogs, social posts, video scripts, etc. Collaborate on long-form content.
  • Provide feedback to the content and design teams based on local market trends.

Lead Generation & Nurturing

  • Execute campaigns that convert regional leads into opportunities.
  • Work with sales teams in-region to ensure lead handling is seamless.
  • Analyze funnel activity across Europe to adjust messaging and targeting.

Measurement & Reporting

  • Monitor and report on campaign performance specific to each region.
  • Track pipeline contribution, ROI, and influenced revenue at a regional level.

 

Qualifications:

What you’ll bring/what we're looking for...

  • 5+ years minimum B2B campaign or demand generation, with experience targeting European countries, (experience targeting Middle East markets will be a plus)
  • Deep understanding of European markets and media landscapes (knowledge of ME will be a plus)
  • Experience supporting organizations within the B2B Digital Transformation industry
  • Strong track record executing regional campaigns across digital and physical channels
  • Fluency with MarTech including Marketo, Salesforce, ABM platforms
  • Analytical, data-driven, and comfortable working across time zones
  • Experience collaborating with regional sales teams and localizing GTM strategy
  • Ability to work within UK Time Zone + ability to travel to London, UK office as needed


 

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.title: カスタマーサポート/日本語
job.url: https://jobs.sutherlandglobal.com/job-details/カスタマーサポート日本語-in-corporate-jobs-1123290
job.description:
Company Description:

【弊社について】

本社を NY に構え、デジタル変革のソリューションを提供するグローバルな BPO（ビジネスプ

ロセスアウトソーシング）企業です。

デジタル技術を活用して、企業のビジネスプロセスを変革し、効率的に管理するためのソリュ

ーションを提供しております。全世界に約 60 拠点、約 4 万人のグローバルプロフェッショナル

スタッフが在籍。

マレーシアの拠点では日本語のカスタマーサポートプロジェクトを中心に拡大中。

Job Description:

【仕事内容】

～プロジェクト拡大に伴い、新メンバー募集～

日本語の EC サイトを利用している日本人のお客様からのお問い合わせ対応をお任せします。

【具体的には】

業務には日本語を使用します。

お客様は日本人なので、電話やメール、チャットでのお問い合わせに対して、日本語で対応し

ていただきます。

～具体的なお問い合わせ内容～

お客様サポートチーム

• 注文した商品が届かない

• 届いた商品とイメージが違うので、返品したい

• 支払い画面でエラー表示されて進めない

物流サポートチーム

• 物流パートナーと配送に関しての対応• お客様の荷物の追跡サポート

★サポート内容に関しては、

マニュアルをご用意しているので、

それに沿って進めていただけます。

★周囲の先輩もサポートするので

ご安心ください。

充実の研修をご用意。

渡航後に約 1 ヶ月間の研修を行います。

前半は、システムの説明やお客様の応対例を中心に学びます。

後半は、トレーナーにサポートしてもらいながら、お客様応対を行っていきましょう。

覚えることはたくさんありますが、丁寧に教えていくので、

あなたのペースで成長していきましょう。

*＼ ここにも注目 ／*

『１』

日本語の EC サイトの

カスタマーサポート業務です。

そのため、自身が利用者になったつもりで、

お客様のお悩み事を解決していきましょう！

『２』

プロジェクトは拡大中！

今後も拡大予定で、また新規のプロジェクトも

予定をしておりますので、

中長期に渡り活躍のチャンスがございます

マネジメントなどに興味がある方も

大歓迎です◎

Qualifications:

【対象となる方】

★海外勤務やカスタマーサポート経験がない方も大歓迎です★ ◎基本的な PC スキルがある方

◎高卒以上 ◎コミュニケーション能力がある方

【 応募条件 】

• 高卒の方：職歴 7 年以以上

• 専門卒・短大卒の方：職歴 3 年以上

• 大卒の方：職歴不問

• 外国籍の方：N２取得以上、一年以上のカスタマーサポート経験がある方

【歓迎条件】

• カスタマーサポート経験がある方

• E コマース業界での経験がある方

• 何かしらの顧客対応経験がある方業界・業種は一切不問です。

海外勤務に興味がある方、

語学スキルを高めたい方はぜひご応募ください。

 

Additional Information:

【福利厚生】

• 医療保険

┗ 歯科もカバーしていて、

医療水準の高いマレーシアでも安心して生活できます。

• 産休・育休制度

• 就労ビザ手配

• 日本からマレーシアへの片道航空券

• マレーシア到着後、2 週間の宿泊施設提供

• 空港ピックアップサービス• 研修制度

• オフィスカジュアル

• 髪型自由

• 現地の不動産会社のご紹介

• 銀行口座開設（銀行担当者がオフィスに来てくれます）

job.title: Lead - QA
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking an attentive and analytical person to join us as a Quality Analyst. The Quality Analyst is a front-line position responsible for the evaluation and documentation of customer transaction to ensure accurate and consistent information is provided to customer. The Quality Specialist key focus is to evaluate transactions to ensure all required processes and guidelines are followed to ensure the delivery of the highest levels of customer experience and employee engagement, while driving KPI performance at or above all critical goals

 

Job Description:

Responsibilities:

This individual is responsible for completing all assigned transaction evaluation and attending all internal and external calibration sessions as assigned. Quality Analyst in this role get to:

 Define Sutherland’s reputation: Oversee and manage performance and service quality to guarantee customer satisfaction.

Strengthen relationships: Establish and maintain communication with clients and/or team members; understand needs, resolve issues, and meet expectations.

Keep management updated: Relay important information in the form of timely and accurate reports.

Impact the bottom line: Produce solid and effective strategies based on accurate and meaningful data reports and analysis and/or keen observations.

Qualifications:

Our most successful candidates will have:

  • Six months experience in process transformation.
  • Ability to work in MS Office.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Pro-active ability in developing trust and professional rapport with employees and team members; work as a team-player.
  • Strong analytical skills; be able to interpret data, identify trends, and make suggestions for improvements.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; be able to communicate in a clear, constructive, and professional manner.

Additional Information:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

job.title: ERP - TAGUIG
job.description:
Company Description:

Sutherland is seeking a dynamic and intuitive person to join us as a Professional Talent Acquisition / Recruiter. We are a group of energetic and hard-working individuals. If you are looking to build a fulfilling career and are confident you have the skills and experience to help us succeed, we want to work with you!

Job Description:

"1. Supports across live chat, email, phone, Social Media, and App reviews.
2. Upholds the Disney brand, champions fan loyalty, and the Guest experience. 
3. Delivers exceptional Guest Service, to achieve required customer satisfaction targets. 
4. Responds and resolves Guest queries efficiently, in a timely manner. 
5. Maintains up to date knowledge of products and updates to the product. 
6. Adheres to and follows any Disney processes to resolve Guest queries. 
7. Ensures that any or all relevant Guest information, and detail of query, is recorded accurately and timely in the CRM. 
8. Takes ownership of queries or complaints raised by Guests, to resolve their concerns. 
9. Maintains a clear and consistent tone of voice that reflects the Disney brand in line with quality and language guidelines. 
10. Highlights any potential contact drivers and shares learnings gathered with Disney GX team. 
11. Demonstrates a full understanding of the business processes, procedures, and relevant product knowledge and systems so that accurate information is provided to the Guest at all times. "            
 

Qualifications:

  • Has good written and spoken communication skills
  • Is confident in decision making, in line with business processes supplied
  • Has basic computer skills, typing/keyboard skills and experience in navigating across different IT systems
  • Prefer experience working in customer service or contact center
  • Has experience working in a fast-paced environment, with changing business priorities. 
  • Has completed High School level or K-12
  • Has a passion for providing an exceptional Guest experience
  • Enjoys taking ownership of queries
  • Has great attention to detail and is well organizedIs a conscientious and reliable individual who is passionate, enthusiastic, and a team player, with a positive attitude. 
  • Demonstrates a strong understanding of customer satisfaction and service excellence.

job.title: REFERRALS 2023 - MEXICO
job.description:
Company Description:

Do you excel at handling customer inquiries, multi-tasking and hitting performance targets? Do you have strong active listening skills and an enthusiastic personality? Can you build rapport online, while asking probing questions to address issues and solve problems using templated solutions?

Join us.

Job Description:

Sutherland now seeks Customer Service Representatives to provide assistance for customers of our major gaming client. In this role, you will bring your positive energy, enthusiasm and expertise to deliver exceptional service and solutions to customers, on site at our Windsor center. You will get to work with leading technologies and systems while having a dedicated team of leaders and peers to support you each and every day. 

What we offer:

  • Competitive base salary from $13,000 up to $18,000 MXN
  • Medical, dental and vision benefits
  • Paid training & PTO
  • Advancement opportunities – 80% of our frontline leaders have been promoted from within
  • Additional pay incentives as well as monthly rewards & recognition programs
  • Employee Discounts

Qualifications:

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; candidates will complete a language test to assess fluency
  • The ability to navigate in several computer platforms simultaneously
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office tools
  • Experience in customer service and/or call center
  • High school diploma or equivalent

Additional Information:

    About Us:

    At Sutherland, you can grow your own way, do interesting things, and be yourself. Our teams thrive in an environment of diversity of thought, experiences, and background – we celebrate and embrace our diversity, whole-heartedly. As a digital transformation company, we rethink and rebuild processes for the digital age by combining the speed and insight of design thinking with the scale and accuracy of data analytics. We have been helping customers globally, across industries from financial services to healthcare, achieve greater agility through transformed and automated customer experiences for over 35 years.
